title: FRM® Part II Complete Course
shortDescription: Applied risk management: market, credit, operational and liquidity risk, investment risk and current issues.
description: Part II applies the Part I toolkit to how financial institutions actually measure and manage risk. The course covers market risk measurement, credit risk, operational risk and resilience, liquidity and treasury risk, risk management of investments, and current issues.
whoFor: Candidates who have passed FRM® Part I
Risk professionals in banks, insurers and asset managers
outcomes: Estimate and backtest VaR and expected shortfall
Model credit risk, counterparty exposure and CVA
Measure operational risk and design resilience frameworks
Manage liquidity, funding and treasury risk
Apply risk budgeting and performance attribution to portfolios

faq.q: Is the full course available now?
faq.a: The course structure is published. Lessons are released progressively.
